evidence.reason: unescapeXml only matches the five predefined entities and numeric references; any other `&name;` survives unchanged. Since the codec represents itself as an XML plist parser and refuses entity declarations, an undeclared entity is malformed XML and should fail rather than be returned as literal text. This is an implementation defect in existing parsing behavior, not a request to add a new requirement; the smallest compatible fix is to reject unmatched/unknown references while still decoding valid text such as `&unknown;`.
